title: The completion map of a G-ring is regular
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the completion of a G-ring with respect to an ideal is a regular ring map. The statement carries a literature reference for the result, and the text supplies its own proof: flatness and Noetherianity of the completion reduce the claim to the local criterion for regularity, where a maximal ideal of the completion lying over a maximal ideal of the ring is shown to give a flat local map identifying residue fields and with equal maximal ideals, hence an isomorphism on completions. Faithful flatness of the next completion map then lets the permanence lemma for regular maps be applied to the two-step chain, and the outer map is regular precisely because the ring is a G-ring.
